from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
import json, uuid
class Forms(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.forms=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        d=dict(attrs)
        if tag=='form': self.forms.append([])
        if tag=='input' and self.forms and d.get('name'): self.forms[-1].append((d['name'], d.get('value','')))
p=Forms(); p.feed(urlopen('http://localhost:3000/').read().decode())

books=json.load(open('data/books.json'))

from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
import json, uuid
class Forms(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.forms=[]; self.current=None
    def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
        d=dict(attrs)
        if tag=='form': self.current=[]; self.forms.append(self.current)
        elif tag=='input' and self.current is not None and d.get('name'): self.current.append((d['name'],d.get('value','')))
    def handle_endtag(self,tag):
        if tag=='form': self.current=None
book=json.load(open('data/books.json'))[0]
